newsitem.title: EGYPT: Russian minister will discuss new ideas in Mideast.
newsitem.headline: Russian minister will discuss new ideas in Mideast.

text.p: Russia, a nominal joint sponsor of Middle East peace talks, will discuss new ideas when Foreign Minister Yevgeny Primakov visits the region at the end of the month, his deputy said on Tuesday.

On a stopover at Cairo airport on his way to Jeddah in Saudi Arabia, deputy foreign minister Victor Posuvalyuk told reporters that Primakov would visit Egypt, Jordan, Syria, Lebanon, Israel and the Palestinian territories.

"On his tour Mr Primakov will discuss new ideas and positions which are far from being routine or cliches, since the minister has a broad vision of matters backed by his knowledge of the contemporary history of the Middle East," he said. He gave no details of the ideas.
The minister was a Soviet ambassador in the Middle East for many years.
Posuvalyuk said that in Saudi Arabia he would have discussions with Saudi officials on what he called important regional issues. He again gave no details.

The Soviet Union and the United States were joint sponsors at the Madrid peace conference in 1991 but the Russian government has since taken a back seat because of its preoccupation with internal problems.
